add.description: Almost every process gets an end line; 4 claude.exe ends were missed; agents launched outside Servex were invisible (fixed).
add.text:
Rerun: `node Servex/pid-coverage.mjs` (numbers 2026-11-08 13:45 UTC).

| kind | starts | with end | with agent+session |
|---|---|---|---|
| claude.exe | 36 | 88.9% | 100% |
| node | 517 | 99.2% | 16.4% |
| git | 506 | 99.4% | 17.6% |
| shell | 202 | 97.5% | 70.3% |
| chrome (playwright) | 16 | 100% | 100% |
| other | 280 | 99.3% | 39.3% |

- **Missed ends:** 4 claude.exe exits were never logged (2 more are live agents). Small gap, not yet traced.
- **Short shells:** about 1 in 22 is ever seen by the 10 s sampler; they end before the next sample, so it's a visibility gap, not a leak.
- **Low attribution** for node/git is expected: they're sampled grandchildren walked up to the nearest tracked parent.
- **Bypass fixed** (a692f261c): page-design started 3 agents with `claude -p` when the worktree pool was empty; they had zero pid lines. The mastermind role now allows that only when Servex itself is unreachable. None are still running.

Report: /framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-resources/pid-accounting/report.md
